BEHEMOTH! | Official Teaser | Searchlight Pictures
A gifted cellist, Alex Serian (Pedro Pascal), returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road.

Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

Written & Directed by: Tony Gilroy
Produced By: Tony Gilroy, Sanne Wohlenberg and John Gilroy
Starring: Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, Alexa Swinton, Kaya Ralls, Erik Griffin, Jobeth Williams, Margarita Levieva, with Hank Azaria and Will Arnett.
